statement: Aligning text-extracted (passage-derived) triples to reference-KB facts is an established, non-trivial task, and the mapping is not always possible because extracted triples tend to be more specific than KB facts.

evidence.quote: Many of these downstream tasks rely on aligning OIE triples with reference KBs.
We found that such mappings are not always possible because the information in the OIE triples tends to be more specific.
